_doc: Package WP2 (docs/14-m4-plan.md §2.6): a fork's cost in live-tick equivalents per map, phi = ms / live ms per tick (the runner's tick plus apex's think, mean of the 200 ticks before the probe), the median over probes at ticks 2400, 4800 and 7200 of quick-suite games 0-15 (apex defaults). fork: ctx.fork() (a structural clone of the live game, AgentHost's default forkMode); take: GameFork.source() on that fork; clone: ForkSource.fork(). A search pays fork + take + clone for its first rollout and a clone for each other. Maps not listed cost the fallback (above the 90th percentile of the measured maps).
measured: PROVISIONAL (take, clone from ab3208e; fork = take + clone)
